changelog: Fix: requested items could sit at Importing until the next scheduled library scan. Once Radarr/Sonarr have imported a title, the plugin asks Jellyfin to scan that folder (falling back to scanning Movies/Shows libraries if Jellyfin cannot see the path), so the real item appears and the placeholder goes away within minutes.
description: Keeps a shared "Coming Soon" library of requested movies and shows that haven't arrived yet, with download progress and ETA in the item overview. Placeholder items are not playable.
name: Coming Soon
overview: Download progress library for Seerr, Sonarr and Radarr
